title: Rate Bands for Late Charges, Workplace Cafe Management Program
content:
Two facts on a Workplace Cafe Management Program contract settle the late charge rate: how many late charges already stand raised on the contract in the twenty-four months up to the day this charge is raised, and whether the amount still outstanding reaches the heavy arrears threshold.

Point one, the rule. Where two or more late charges stand raised on the contract in the twenty-four months up to the day this charge is raised and the amount still outstanding reaches the heavy arrears threshold, the late charge rate is the repeat arrears rate; where fewer than two late charges stand raised over those twenty-four months and the amount still outstanding reaches the heavy arrears threshold, the late charge rate is the first arrears rate; and where the amount still outstanding falls below the heavy arrears threshold, the late charge rate is the monthly late charge percentage printed against the service model.

Point two, the figures. The heavy arrears threshold is 30000.00 USD. The repeat arrears rate is 1.6 per cent a month. The first arrears rate is 1.3 per cent a month.

Point three, the order of the two facts. The amount still outstanding is judged first: where it falls below 30000.00 USD the late charge rate is the monthly late charge percentage printed against the service model, whatever the count of late charges already standing. Only where the amount still outstanding reaches 30000.00 USD does that count decide between the repeat arrears rate and the first arrears rate.

Point four, the window on the count. The late charges counted are those standing raised on the contract in the twenty-four months up to the day this charge is raised; the charge now being raised is not among them.

Point five, worked on hypothetical figures. On a hypothetical contract with an amount still outstanding of 41500.00 USD and 3 late charges standing raised over those twenty-four months, the late charge rate is the repeat arrears rate, 1.6 per cent a month. With the same amount still outstanding and 1 late charge standing raised, the late charge rate is the first arrears rate, 1.3 per cent a month.

Point six, the threshold on both sides. A hypothetical amount still outstanding of 30000.00 USD reaches the heavy arrears threshold and the count of late charges decides the rate; a hypothetical amount still outstanding of 29999.99 USD falls below it, and the late charge rate is the monthly late charge percentage printed against the service model.
